    # -10.0*v: reduced from -155 to avoid overcorrection from velocity

    # Clamp force to physical limits
    lim = CART_FORCE_LIMIT_NEWTONS
    sandbox.apply_cart_force(max(-lim, min(lim, force)))

    edge_scaling = 1.0
    # Aggressive edge scaling when near the boundary
    if abs(x - left_edge) < 0.05 or abs(x - right_edge) < 0.05:
        edge_scaling = 0.9  # Slightly reduce force when near edge

    # Calculate control force with adjusted gains and edge-based scaling
    # Reduced gains for stability and edge safety
    position_error = target_x - x
    force = (0.1 * position_error) + (-0.05 * theta) + (-0.05 * omega) + (-0.01 * v)
    force *= edge_scaling  # Apply edge scaling

    # Clamp force to physical limits
    lim = CART_FORCE_LIMIT_NEWTONS
    sandbox.apply_cart_force(max(-lim, min(lim, force)))
